New collaborations and banking projects were established including the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Admin
urls.title: The NIST Biorepository

data.text:
What looks like a witch’s cauldron is actually an ultracold freezer that holds marine animal tissue samples. This is part of the NIST Biorepository at the Hollings Marine Lab in Charleston, South Carolina. 

Learn more: https://t.co/TycWTIDUKk https://t.co/YxLumGmEMB
